# dokploy_postgres_start (Action)

Deploys and starts a Dokploy PostgreSQL service when it is stopped. A running service is left as it is. postgres.start scales the service to one replica, so it runs only when the configured replica count is 1.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `postgres_id` (String) ID of the dokploy_postgres instance to deploy and start.
